_comment: A throwaway key and one signed record per update asset, served by the local fake feeds of the feed-only install tests (Windows test_asset_signature.ahk, Linux test_changelog_release_install.lua): with the API unavailable the newest feed release installs only once its downloaded asset's size and SHA-256 rebuild a record this key signed. content is the asset body the fake transport serves (Linux stubs its digest, so only its size counts there). The private key was discarded; tools/test/test-update-asset-signature.cjs replays both records with the reference verifier.
